The inventory sheet's indoor unit model H18SEH17XAE does not appear in TCL's Elite series specification sheet. The Elite 18K models are H18SEH19XAE and H18SEH19XAC (AHRI 215387254). The digits in that position are a platform code, not an efficiency rating -- H09SEH19 rates SEER2 19 while H12SEH19 rates 21 -- so ...17... cannot be read as a 17 SEER2 variant of the same unit. Either the sheet transposed 19 as 17, or this is stock from a different TCL platform. Read the rating plate before publishing or reordering.

Elite 18K specifications are deliberately NOT copied onto this record. Applying H18SEH19 data to a unit labelled H18SEH17 would be exactly the family-substitution error this catalogue is meant to prevent.
